newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy funds May inflow seen above 5.7 trln lire.
newsitem.headline: Italy funds May inflow seen above 5.7 trln lire.

text.p: The inflow into Italy's mutual funds in May is seen at more than 5.7 trillion lire, with share funds gaining more than 1.1 trillion lire, the Italian fund managers association Assogestioni said.
In April, the net inflow into Italy's mutual funds was 4.964 trillion lire, with 768 billion lire going into share funds.
The statement said that of the inflow into share funds in May, a significant rise came from investments in overseas share markets. Italian share funds now totalled 255 trillion lire.
It added that for the first five months of 1997, the inflow into mutual funds was almost 50 trillion lire.
Assogestioni said it will publish complete results for the month of May on Thursday June 5.
